map.俄罗斯方块适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Tetris best for?
map.经典消行游戏，支持键盘和触控操作: Classic line-clearing game, with keyboard and touch controls
map.七种方块（I/O/T/S/Z/J/L）下落，旋转移动填满整行即消除并得分；堆顶触: Seven tetrominoes (I/O/T/S/Z/J/L) fall; rotate and move to fill a row, which clears for points; the game ends when the stack tops out. Higher level means faster drops.
map.一次同时消 4 行（Tetris）得 800×(等级+1) 分；等级 3 时单消: Clearing 4 rows at once (a Tetris) scores 800 x (level+1); at level 3, one 4-row clear scores 3200. Score is stored locally, no network.
map.视实现而定；基础版支持旋转移动与硬降，进阶版可加暂存与下一块预览。: Depends on the build; the basic version supports rotate/move and hard drop, the advanced can add hold and next-piece preview.
map.最高分存本地；对局中断不续，纯前端娱乐。: The high score is local; a session does not resume after interruption, pure-frontend fun.
map.俄罗斯方块（Tetris）是经典的益智游戏，玩家需要移动和旋转下落的方块，填满整: Tetris is a classic puzzle game where you move and rotate falling blocks to fill rows and clear them for points. As levels rise, the drop speed increases, testing your reaction and strategy.
map.每消除10行升一级，速度加快: Every 10 rows cleared levels up and speeds up
map.方块堆到顶部则游戏结束: Stack reaching the top ends the game
map.键盘：方向键移动旋转，空格硬降: Keyboard: arrows to move/rotate, Space to hard drop
map.暂停：P键或暂停按钮: Pause: P key or pause button
map.幽灵方块显示落点预览: Ghost piece shows the landing preview
